answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to held assets. By tethering identity to capital, the network creates a cooling ember of trust that prevents cheap identity proliferation. Like the sturdy cedar root system, stake-weighted voting anchors the protocol, ensuring that even a rising tide of malicious agents cannot overwhelm the consensus. Attackers must bear the heavy financial cost of devaluing their own equity to compromise the chain.
